description:
[Trading Data API] Free API key, step 1: get the exact message to sign for a wallet. No funds needed; any wallet you control works (including smart-contract wallets).

**Example:** `/v1/keys/message?wallet=0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001`

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

wallet.description: Required. The 0x wallet address that will sign and own the key.

name: keys_message
